expected_rate: once on every weekly post-mortem run that publishes figures (Saturday or Sunday morning)
window_reason: The report runs only on weekend mornings; nine calendar days from the ship date always include one full weekend.
reversal: a dollar figure in the Slack post differs from logs/wtp_<date>.md, the tier lines do not add up to the headline without the mismatch warning, or a loss shows without a minus sign and 🔻
